' RV01 Chassis - rebuilt from the SolidWorks API dump (generated by rebuild_dump/gen_sw_macro.py)
' SolidWorks 2025, late bound. Paste into a new macro module (Tools > Macro > New) and run main.
' All coordinates are model space, metres. Up-to-* end conditions were resolved to blind depths
' by the build123d rebuild; fillet/chamfer edges are picked at their midpoints.
Option Explicit

Dim swApp As Object
Dim mu As Object
Dim logPath As String
Dim nOK As Long, nFail As Long
Dim gNormal As Variant
Dim gDoc As Object
Dim gExpect As Double
Dim gSketch As String
Dim gRegionMiss As Boolean

Sub LogErr(ByVal what As String)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then LogLine "  ERR " & what & ": " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    Err.Clear
End Sub

Sub LogLine(ByVal s As String)
    Dim fn As Integer
    fn = FreeFile
    Open logPath For Append As #fn
    Print #fn, Format(Now, "hh:nn:ss") & "  " & s
    Close #fn
End Sub

Sub LogBodies()
    On Error Resume Next
    Dim bodies As Variant, i As Long, v As Double, mp As Variant, n As Long
    bodies = gDoc.GetBodies2(0, True)
    If IsArray(bodies) Then
        n = UBound(bodies) + 1
        For i = 0 To UBound(bodies)
            mp = bodies(i).GetMassProperties(1)
            If IsArray(mp) Then v = v + mp(3)
        Next
    End If
    LogLine "       bodies=" & n & " volume=" & Format(v * 1E+9, "0.0") & " mm3  (build123d expects " & Format(gExpect, "0.0") & ")"
    Err.Clear
    ' show progress: redraw and pause 0.5 s
    gDoc.GraphicsRedraw2
    gDoc.ViewZoomtofit2
    Dim t As Single: t = Timer
    Do While Timer < t + 0.5: DoEvents: Loop
    Err.Clear
End Sub

Function Report(ByVal feat As Object, ByVal nm As String, ByVal extra As String) As Boolean
    If feat Is Nothing Then
        nFail = nFail + 1
        LogLine "FAIL " & nm & " " & extra & IIf(Err.Number <> 0, " err=" & Err.Description, "")
        Report = False
    Else
        feat.Name = nm
        nOK = nOK + 1
        LogLine "OK   " & nm & " " & extra
    End If
    Err.Clear
    LogBodies
    If feat Is Nothing Then
        Report = False
    Else
        Report = True
    End If
    Err.Clear
End Function

' model point -> sketch point of the active sketch
Function ToSk(ByVal m As Object, ByVal x As Double, ByVal y As Double, ByVal z As Double) As Variant
    Dim a(2) As Double, p As Object
    a(0) = x: a(1) = y: a(2) = z
    Set p = mu.CreatePoint(a)
    Set p = p.MultiplyTransform(m.SketchManager.ActiveSketch.ModelToSketchTransform)
    ToSk = p.ArrayData
End Function

' sketch normal (model space) of the active sketch
Function SkNormal(ByVal m As Object) As Variant
    Dim a(2) As Double, v As Object
    a(2) = 1
    Set v = mu.CreateVector(a)
    Set v = v.MultiplyTransform(m.SketchManager.ActiveSketch.ModelToSketchTransform.Inverse)
    SkNormal = v.ArrayData
End Function

Function SkOriginAxis(ByVal m As Object, ByVal ax As Integer) As Double
    Dim a(2) As Double, p As Object
    Set p = mu.CreatePoint(a)
    Set p = p.MultiplyTransform(m.SketchManager.ActiveSketch.ModelToSketchTransform.Inverse)
    SkOriginAxis = p.ArrayData(ax)
End Function

' open a sketch on std plane stdName, or on a plane offset d (m) from it (same orientation as the parent).
' (nx,ny,nz) = sketch normal in model space, known at generation time.
Function BeginSketch(ByVal m As Object, ByVal stdName As String, ByVal d As Double, ByVal nx As Double, ByVal ny As Double, ByVal nz As Double) As Boolean
    Dim pl As Object
    BeginSketch = False
    m.ClearSelection2 True
    m.Extension.SelectByID2 stdName, "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0
    LogErr "select " & stdName
    If Abs(d) > 0.0000001 Then
        If d < 0 Then
            Set pl = m.FeatureManager.InsertRefPlane(8 + 256, Abs(d), 0, 0, 0, 0)
        Else
            Set pl = m.FeatureManager.InsertRefPlane(8, Abs(d), 0, 0, 0, 0)
        End If
        LogErr "InsertRefPlane"
        If pl Is Nothing Then LogLine "  WARN ref plane failed at " & d: Exit Function
        m.ClearSelection2 True
        pl.Select2 False, 0
    End If
    m.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    LogErr "InsertSketch"
    If m.SketchManager.ActiveSketch Is Nothing Then LogLine "  WARN no active sketch on " & stdName & " d=" & d: Exit Function
    m.SketchManager.AddToDB = True
    m.SketchManager.DisplayWhenAdded = False
    gNormal = Array(nx, ny, nz)
    CheckFrame m, stdName, d, nx, ny, nz
    BeginSketch = True
End Function

' log the real sketch frame: where model points O=d*n, O+X_std, O+Y_std land in sketch space.
' expected (0,0), (1,0), (0,1); anything else means the literal coordinates are on the wrong frame.
Sub CheckFrame(ByVal m As Object, ByVal stdName As String, ByVal d As Double, ByVal nx As Double, ByVal ny As Double, ByVal nz As Double)
    Dim v As Variant, r(8) As Double, t(2) As Double, sc As Double, i As Integer
    Dim ox As Double, oy As Double, oz As Double, ux As Double, uy As Double, uz As Double, wx As Double, wy As Double, wz As Double
    Dim p(2) As Double, q(2, 2) As Double, k As Integer, msg As String, bad As Boolean
    v = m.SketchManager.ActiveSketch.ModelToSketchTransform.ArrayData
    If Not IsArray(v) Then LogLine "  WARN no sketch transform": Err.Clear: Exit Sub
    For i = 0 To 8: r(i) = CDbl(v(i)): Next
    For i = 0 To 2: t(i) = CDbl(v(9 + i)): Next
    sc = CDbl(v(12))
    ox = d * nx: oy = d * ny: oz = d * nz
    Select Case stdName                         ' std sketch axes X / Y in model
        Case "Front Plane": ux = 1: uy = 0: uz = 0: wx = 0: wy = 1: wz = 0
        Case "Top Plane": ux = 1: uy = 0: uz = 0: wx = 0: wy = 0: wz = -1
        Case Else: ux = 0: uy = 0: uz = -1: wx = 0: wy = 1: wz = 0
    End Select
    For k = 0 To 2
        p(0) = ox: p(1) = oy: p(2) = oz
        If k = 1 Then p(0) = ox + ux: p(1) = oy + uy: p(2) = oz + uz
        If k = 2 Then p(0) = ox + wx: p(1) = oy + wy: p(2) = oz + wz
        For i = 0 To 2
            q(k, i) = sc * (p(0) * r(i) + p(1) * r(3 + i) + p(2) * r(6 + i)) + t(i)
        Next
    Next
    bad = Abs(q(0, 0)) + Abs(q(0, 1)) + Abs(q(0, 2)) > 0.000001
    bad = bad Or Abs(q(1, 0) - q(0, 0) - 1) + Abs(q(1, 1) - q(0, 1)) > 0.000001
    bad = bad Or Abs(q(2, 0) - q(0, 0)) + Abs(q(2, 1) - q(0, 1) - 1) > 0.000001
    msg = "  frame " & stdName & " d=" & d & ": O->(" & Format(q(0, 0), "0.0000") & "," & Format(q(0, 1), "0.0000") & "," & Format(q(0, 2), "0.0000") & _
          ") X->(" & Format(q(1, 0) - q(0, 0), "0.00") & "," & Format(q(1, 1) - q(0, 1), "0.00") & ") Y->(" & Format(q(2, 0) - q(0, 0), "0.00") & "," & Format(q(2, 1) - q(0, 1), "0.00") & ")"
    If bad Then LogLine "  WARN FRAME MISMATCH" & msg Else LogLine msg
    Err.Clear
End Sub

' hide every ref plane and sketch
Sub HideRefs(ByVal m As Object)
    Dim ft As Object, tn As String
    Set ft = m.FirstFeature
    Do While Not ft Is Nothing
        tn = ft.GetTypeName2
        If tn = "RefPlane" Or tn = "ProfileFeature" Then
            m.ClearSelection2 True
            ft.Select2 False, 0
            If tn = "RefPlane" Then m.BlankRefGeom Else m.BlankSketch
        End If
        Set ft = ft.GetNextFeature
    Loop
    m.ClearSelection2 True
    Err.Clear
End Sub

Sub EndSketch(ByVal m As Object, ByVal nm As String)
    Dim sk As Object
    Dim segs As Variant, n As Long
    Set sk = m.SketchManager.ActiveSketch
    n = -1
    If Not sk Is Nothing Then segs = sk.GetSketchSegments: If IsArray(segs) Then n = UBound(segs) + 1 Else n = 0
    LogErr "GetSketchSegments"
    m.SketchManager.AddToDB = False
    m.SketchManager.DisplayWhenAdded = True
    m.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    LogErr "InsertSketch(exit)"
    gSketch = m.FeatureByPositionReverse(0).Name
    m.FeatureByPositionReverse(0).Name = nm
    If Err.Number = 0 Then gSketch = nm
    Err.Clear
    LogLine "  sketch " & gSketch & " segments=" & n
    m.ClearSelection2 True
    gRegionMiss = False
End Sub

Sub SelRegion(ByVal m As Object, ByVal x As Double, ByVal y As Double, ByVal z As Double)
    If Not m.Extension.SelectByID2("", "SKETCHREGION", x, y, z, True, 4, Nothing, 0) Then
        If Not m.Extension.SelectByID2("", "SKETCHREGION", x, y, z, True, 0, Nothing, 0) Then
            LogLine "  WARN region pick missed at " & x & "," & y & "," & z
            gRegionMiss = True
        End If
    End If
    LogErr "SelRegion"
End Sub

' nearest body edge to (x,y,z) by enumeration + closest point; SelectByID2 only as a fallback
Sub SelEdge(ByVal m As Object, ByVal x As Double, ByVal y As Double, ByVal z As Double)
    Dim bodies As Variant, edges As Variant, i As Long, j As Long, cp As Variant
    Dim best As Object, bd As Double, d As Double, sd As Object
    bd = 1E+30
    bodies = m.GetBodies2(0, True)
    If IsArray(bodies) Then
        For i = 0 To UBound(bodies)
            edges = bodies(i).GetEdges
            If IsArray(edges) Then
                For j = 0 To UBound(edges)
                    cp = edges(j).GetClosestPointOn(x, y, z)
                    If IsArray(cp) Then
                        d = Sqr((cp(0) - x) ^ 2 + (cp(1) - y) ^ 2 + (cp(2) - z) ^ 2)
                        If d < bd Then bd = d: Set best = edges(j)
                    End If
                Next
            End If
        Next
    End If
    LogErr "edge enum"
    If Not best Is Nothing And bd < 0.0002 Then
        Set sd = m.SelectionManager.CreateSelectData
        sd.Mark = 1
        If best.Select4(True, sd) Then Exit Sub
        LogErr "Select4"
    End If
    If Not m.Extension.SelectByID2("", "EDGE", x, y, z, True, 1, Nothing, 0) Then
        LogLine "  WARN edge pick missed at " & x & "," & y & "," & z & " (nearest " & Format(bd * 1000, "0.000") & " mm)"
    End If
    Err.Clear
End Sub

' mode: one | two | thru | both_thru ; (nx,ny,nz) = wanted direction 1
Sub DoExtrude(ByVal m As Object, ByVal nm As String, ByVal isCut As Boolean, ByVal mode As String, ByVal d1 As Double, ByVal d2 As Double, ByVal nx As Double, ByVal ny As Double, ByVal nz As Double)
    Dim f As Object, dflt As Double, rev As Boolean, sd As Boolean, t1 As Long, t2 As Long, tmp As Double
    dflt = gNormal(0) * nx + gNormal(1) * ny + gNormal(2) * nz
    If isCut Then dflt = -dflt                     ' cuts default to the -normal side
    rev = (dflt < 0)
    sd = True: t1 = 0: t2 = 0
    Select Case mode
        Case "thru": t1 = 1
        Case "both_thru": sd = False: t1 = 1: t2 = 1: rev = False
        Case "two": sd = False: If rev Then tmp = d1: d1 = d2: d2 = tmp: rev = False
    End Select
    Dim attempt As Integer
    If gRegionMiss Or m.SelectionManager.GetSelectedObjectCount2(-1) = 0 Then
        LogLine "  region selection incomplete -> whole sketch " & gSketch
        m.ClearSelection2 True
        m.Extension.SelectByID2 gSketch, "SKETCH", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0
    End If
    For attempt = 0 To 1
    If isCut Then
        Set f = m.FeatureManager.FeatureCut4(sd, False, rev, t1, t2, d1, d2, False, False, False, False, 0, 0, False, False, False, False, False, True, True, True, True, False, 0, 0, False, False)
    Else
        Set f = m.FeatureManager.FeatureExtrusion3(sd, False, rev, t1, t2, d1, d2, False, False, False, False, 0, 0, False, False, False, False, True, True, True, 0, 0, False)
    End If
    LogErr IIf(isCut, "FeatureCut4", "FeatureExtrusion3")
    If Not f Is Nothing Then Exit For
    If attempt = 0 Then
        LogLine "  retry " & nm & " flipped / whole sketch"
        rev = Not rev
        m.ClearSelection2 True
        m.Extension.SelectByID2 gSketch, "SKETCH", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0
    End If
    Next
    Report f, nm, mode & " d1=" & d1 & " d2=" & d2 & " rev=" & rev
End Sub

Sub DoFillet(ByVal m As Object, ByVal nm As String, ByVal r As Double, ByVal nEdges As Long)
    Dim f As Object, nSel As Long
    nSel = m.SelectionManager.GetSelectedObjectCount2(-1)
    Dim vE As Variant
    Set f = m.FeatureManager.FeatureFillet3(195, r, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, vE, vE, vE, vE, vE, vE, vE)
    LogErr "FeatureFillet3"
    If f Is Nothing Then
        Err.Clear
        If m.FeatureFillet(195, r, 0, 0, vE, vE, vE) Then Set f = m.FeatureByPositionReverse(0)
    End If
    Report f, nm, "r=" & r & " edges " & nSel & "/" & nEdges
End Sub

Sub DoChamfer(ByVal m As Object, ByVal nm As String, ByVal d As Double, ByVal ang As Double, ByVal nEdges As Long)
    Dim f As Object, nSel As Long
    nSel = m.SelectionManager.GetSelectedObjectCount2(-1)
    Set f = m.FeatureManager.InsertFeatureChamfer(4, 1, d, ang, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    LogErr "InsertFeatureChamfer"
    Report f, nm, "d=" & d & " edges " & nSel & "/" & nEdges
End Sub

Sub DoMirror(ByVal m As Object, ByVal nm As String, ByVal plane As String, ByVal srcs As String)
    Dim f As Object, s As Variant
    m.ClearSelection2 True
    If Not m.Extension.SelectByID2(plane, "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 2, Nothing, 0) Then LogLine "  WARN mirror plane missing: " & plane
    For Each s In Split(srcs, "|")
        If Not m.Extension.SelectByID2(CStr(s), "BODYFEATURE", 0, 0, 0, True, 1, Nothing, 0) Then LogLine "  WARN mirror source missing: " & s
    Next
    Set f = m.FeatureManager.InsertMirrorFeature2(False, False, False, False, 0)
    LogErr "InsertMirrorFeature2"
    Report f, nm, "of " & srcs
End Sub

Sub main()
    Dim m As Object, folder As String, tpl As String, errs As Long, warns As Long
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set mu = swApp.GetMathUtility
    folder = InputBox("Folder to save RV01_rebuilt.SLDPRT and the log:", "RV01 rebuild", Environ("USERPROFILE") & "\Desktop")
    If folder = "" Then Exit Sub
    If Right(folder, 1) <> "\" Then folder = folder & "\"
    logPath = folder & "RV01_rebuild_log.txt"
    On Error Resume Next
    Kill logPath
    Err.Clear
    LogLine "RV01 Chassis rebuild from dump"
    tpl = swApp.GetUserPreferenceStringValue(8)          ' swDefaultTemplatePart
    Set m = swApp.NewDocument(tpl, 0, 0, 0)
    Set gDoc = m
    If m Is Nothing Then LogLine "FAIL NewDocument (template " & tpl & ")": MsgBox "No part template": Exit Sub
    swApp.SetUserPreferenceToggle 10, False      ' swInputDimValOnCreate off (as in ABTests)
    m.SketchManager.AddToDB = True
    m.SketchManager.DisplayWhenAdded = False

    On Error Resume Next
    F000 m
    On Error Resume Next
    F001 m
    On Error Resume Next
    F002 m
    On Error Resume Next
    F003 m
    On Error Resume Next
    F004 m

    On Error Resume Next

    On Error Resume Next

    On Error Resume Next

    On Error Resume Next

    On Error Resume Next
    F024 m
    On Error Resume Next
    F025 m

    F026 m

    F053 m

    On Error Resume Next
    F055 m

    m.ClearSelection2 True
    m.ForceRebuild3 False
    HideRefs m
    m.ShowNamedView2 "*Isometric", 7
    m.ViewZoomtofit2
    m.Extension.SaveAs folder & "RV01_rebuilt.SLDPRT", 0, 1, Nothing, errs, warns
    LogLine "saved " & folder & "RV01_rebuilt.SLDPRT errs=" & errs & " warns=" & warns
    LogLine "features OK=" & nOK & " FAIL=" & nFail
    MsgBox "RV01 rebuild done: " & nOK & " OK, " & nFail & " failed." & vbCrLf & "Log: " & logPath
End Sub

Sub F000(ByVal m As Object)
  On Error Resume Next
  ' ---- Boss-Extrude1 (Boss, two, regions 3/8)
  If BeginSketch(m, "Front Plane", 0, 0,0,1) Then
    m.SketchManager.CreateLine -0.0175, 0.043, 0, -0.0215, 0.043, 0
    m.SketchManager.CreateLine -0.0215, 0.043, 0, -0.0215, 0.023, 0
    m.SketchManager.CreateLine -0.0215, 0.023, 0, -0.0295, 0.015, 0
    m.SketchManager.CreateLine -0.0295, 0.015, 0, -0.0295, -0.0376, 0
    m.SketchManager.CreateLine -0.0295, -0.0376, 0, 0.0295, -0.0376, 0
    m.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.0295, -0.0376, 0, 0.0295, 0.015, 0
    m.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.0295, 0.015, 0, 0.0215, 0.023, 0
    m.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.0215, 0.023, 0, 0.0215, 0.043, 0
    m.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.0215, 0.043, 0, 0.0175, 0.043, 0
    m.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.0175, 0.043, 0, 0.0175, 0.015, 0
    m.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.0175, 0.015, 0, -0.0175, 0.015, 0
    m.SketchManager.CreateLine -0.0175, 0.015, 0, -0.0175, 0.043, 0
    EndSketch m, "Sketch1"
    m.ClearSelection2 True
    m.Extension.SelectByID2 gSketch, "SKETCH", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0
    gExpect = 57653.8
    DoExtrude m, "Boss-Extrude1", False, "two", 0.0085, 0.0085, 0,0,1
  End If
End Sub

Sub F001(ByVal m As Object)
  On Error Resume Next
  ' ---- Cut-Extrude1 (Cut, both_thru, regions 4/5)
  If BeginSketch(m, "Right Plane", 0, 1,0,0) Then
    m.SketchManager.CreateCircleByRadius -0.0055, 0.0305, 0, 0.0025
    m.SketchManager.CreateCircleByRadius -0.0065, 0.0405, 0, 0.0016
    m.SketchManager.CreateLine -0.00405940315, 0.043, 0, 0.0085, 0.015, 0
    m.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.0085, 0.015, 0, 0.0085, 0.043, 0
    m.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.0085, 0.043, 0, -0.00405940315, 0.043, 0
    m.SketchManager.CreateCircleByRadius 0, -0.0305, 0, 0.0025
    EndSketch m, "Sketch4"
    m.ClearSelection2 True
    m.Extension.SelectByID2 gSketch, "SKETCH", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0
    gExpect = 54790.7126
    DoExtrude m, "Cut-Extrude1", True, "both_thru", 0, 0, -1,-0,-0
  End If
End Sub

    m.SketchManager.CreateCircleByRadius -0.0055, 0.0305, 0, 0.0045
    m.SketchManager.CreateCircleByRadius -0.0055, 0.0305, 0, 0.0025
    m.SketchManager.CreateCircleByRadius -0.0065, 0.0405, 0, 0.00325

    m.Extension.SelectByID2 gSketch, "SKETCH", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0

    DoExtrude m, "Boss-Extrude2", False, "one", 0.004, 0, -1,-0,-0
  End If
End Sub

End Sub

Sub F004(ByVal m As Object)
  On Error Resume Next
  ' ---- Boss-Extrude4 (Boss, one, regions 1/1)
  If BeginSketch(m, "Right Plane", 0.0175, 1,0,0) Then
    m.SketchManager.CreateLine -0.0056, 0.0265, 0, 0.0025, 0.0265, 0
    m.SketchManager.CreateLine -0.0056, 0.0185, 0, -0.0056, 0.0265, 0
    m.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.0025, 0.0185, 0, -0.0056, 0.0185, 0
    m.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.0025, 0.0265, 0, 0.0025, 0.0185, 0
    EndSketch m, "Sketch7"
    m.ClearSelection2 True
    m.Extension.SelectByID2 gSketch, "SKETCH", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0
    gExpect = 55171.3786
    DoExtrude m, "Boss-Extrude4", False, "one", 0.0042, 0, -1,0,0
  End If
End Sub

Sub F005(ByVal m As Object)
  On Error Resume Next
  ' ---- Chamfer1 (4 edges)
  m.ClearSelection2 True
  gExpect = 55162.9786
  SelEdge m, 0.0154,0.0265,-0.0025
  SelEdge m, 0.0154,0.0185,-0.0025

  End If
End Sub
